summary: An autosave hook commits worker-branch work mid-task, so five 'Autosave uncommitted work' commits landed on worker/048795519f43 during change 048795519f43 round 2 and had to be squashed before the real commit

resolution.reason: Duplicate of 0640f118246d, dismissed minutes earlier: the autosave commit is intentional (nothing a worker wrote is lost when a checkout is released); reviewers judge the branch tip against main, never commit by commit; a fixer may reset the pointer to make its one commit, as this one did. Autosave commits on a worker branch are never a finding.
